item.title: VP: Iran documents war environmental damage for global legal pursuit
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - Vice President and Head of the Department of Environment Shina Ansari has said that documented reports on the damage inflicted on the country’s environment—including the release of pollutants, harm to biodiversity, and destruction of natural and wetland habitats—have been prepared and will be used at international environmental summits for legal pursuit.

Tehran, IRNA - Vice President and Head of the Department of Environment Shina Ansari has said that documented reports on the damage inflicted on the country’s environment—including the release of pollutants, harm to biodiversity, and destruction of natural and wetland habitats—have been prepared and will be used at international environmental summits for legal pursuit.

item.title: US attacks caused severe environmental pollution in southern Iran: Official

item.title: Iran’s foreign minister: Environment must not be used as tool of political pressure
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says the environment is a shared heritage of humanity and must not be used as a tool of political pressure or sacrificed to short-term economic and military interests, stressing the importance of international law in protecting the environment during armed conflicts.

item.title: Iran’s nuclear chief challenges US double standards on nuclear technology
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Director of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) Mohammad Eslami has criticized Washington’s double standards on nuclear technology, questioning why the United States prioritizes expanding its own nuclear capabilities while seeking to deny Iran access to the same technology.

item.title: Pezeshkian says national unity can foil enemies’ attempts to weaken Iran
